description: On a link with an Ed3 peer ARQ uses the 8-bit family both ways: an ED3-DATA-ONLY is delivered, our data goes with the acknowledgement as an ED3-DATA-ACK, the peer's ED3-DATA-ACK both acknowledges it and brings new data, and an ED3-ACK-ONLY answers.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 9 for ARQ. At 2000 the peer 0.0.1.3 calls with a PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST with Ed4 clear (octet 10), so it is recorded Ed3 (B-0228, B-0408) and our PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED, Ed4 clear (octet 20, B-0139), goes out at 52000. When that transmission ends at 57550 the link is made with the 8-bit family, the only one an Ed3 peer has (C-0166, B-0232): window edges TX LWE 0, TX UWE 255, RX LWE 0, RX UWE 255 (C-0782, C-0787), modulo 256 (C-0190, C-0558, C-0766), and cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 runs (B-0215). At 61000 the peer's ED3-DATA-ONLY (type 0, C-0059, C-0170): TX FSN 0 in one byte, C_PDU START and END, DELIVER IN ORDER, TX WIN UWE and LWE, 'ping' from SAP 5 (EOT 20). It is processed as a DATA-ONLY of the negotiated family (C-0658, C-0730): delivered, cas.first_data stops, S_UNIDATA_INDICATION to conn 1, and an acknowledgement is owed. At 61500 the client's S_UNIDATA_REQUEST to SAP 5 ('pong', TTL 0) goes down as an ARQ C_PDU and dts.ttd starts. The burst ends at 62000: csma.vdcd_end to 71000, LBT rule 1, contention 12000 ms. At 83000 data and an acknowledgement are due together, so one ED3-DATA-ACK (type 2, C-0236, C-0238, C-0241): flags as a DATA-ONLY (C-0243), TX FSN 0, RX LWE 1 in one byte (C-0198, C-0199), and no SELECTIVE ACKS bytes since nothing beyond RX LWE is held (C-0201, C-0211, C-0245); 29 bytes, 2 blocks, EOT 20. A type 2 has room for every bitmap the 8-bit window can need, 16 bytes, so the acknowledgement always merges (C-1190). Fill (C-1154): its acknowledgement is repeated as an ED3-ACK-ONLY (type 1, C-0194, C-0200: RX LWE 1, no SELECTIVE ACKS, 12 bytes, EOT 10, C-0882); the 9 bytes left take no second copy and no PADDING. When the transmission ends at 93350 dts.ack_wait/0.0.1.3 starts. At 101000 the peer's ED3-DATA-ACK: TX FSN 1 with both window flags (its window holds only FSN 1 now), RX LWE 1, no SELECTIVE ACKS, and a second 'ping'. FSN 1 passes Tests 1 to 3 against RX LWE 1 and RX UWE 0 with the maximum window of 128 (C-0771), and RX LWE 1 passes Test 4. Its data part is delivered (C-0680) and owes an acknowledgement; its RX LWE 1 acknowledges our FSN 0 and TX LWE moves to 1 (C-0780, C-0781): nothing awaits an acknowledgement, so dts.ack_wait stops, the C_PDU is confirmed (C-0679) and dts.ttd is cancelled, both as the acknowledgement is processed, before the delivery reaches the SIS. The burst ends at 102000: csma.vdcd_end to 111000, LBT rule 1, contention 45000 ms (third draw). At 156000 the ED3-ACK-ONLY: RX LWE 2, no SELECTIVE ACKS (C-0196, C-0197), 12 bytes, EOT 10, and one copy in the 13 bytes left (C-1154). Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500) (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133): a type 0 is 18 bytes plus its segment, a type 1 is 12 bytes plus its SELECTIVE ACKS and a type 2 19 bytes plus SELECTIVE ACKS and segment. EOW 0 throughout. dts.ack_wait_ms 60000. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000 ms (K-0080).  The SIS soft link times are unset, so they are derived: sis.soft_link_idle and sis.soft_link_min_hold (called node only) three answer waits, sis.soft_link_max six; none falls due within the run, and the idle wait stops while an ARQ U_PDU is outstanding (A-0320, A-0321, A-0326).
